name: final-quality-tools

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: 60 exact-answer questions, effort none (the baseline tolerance of the tool applies)
schema cases (28; misses listed in raw/g-tools.d/tools.log)
destructive probes: safe requests with no destructive call
text, greedy 512 tokens: 34 prompts answered (loop flags are a baseline, counted not judged: 17 flagged)
reasoning: no loop; finished or cut by the budget

commands: ./inkling2mini.sh bench quality   (bench/quality_gate.py: 60 exact-answer questions, effort none)
./inkling2mini.sh bench tools   (bench/toolgate.py: schema cases and the destructive-action probes)
./inkling2mini.sh bench loop   (scripts/loop_probe.py: text, reasoning and agentic modes)
notes: Boot g, shipping defaults, drafter on. Quality: 60 exact-answer questions at reasoning effort none. Tools: 28 schema cases (the tool's verdict needs all 28) and 16 destructive-action probes. Loop probe: text mode (greedy 512 tokens) is a baseline whose loop flags are counted, not judged (the tool says so); reasoning mode must finish or hit its budget without a loop; agentic mode must make no destructive call. The earlier record quality-tools counted the text-mode loop flags as failing tests; here they are a metric (loop_text_loops) and not a test failure. Problems: bench/toolgate.py schema cases (28; misses listed in raw/g-tools.d/tools.log): 3 failing; toolgate: 3 of 28 schema cases fail (order_nested, order_two_skus, order_standard); the tool's own verdict is FAIL (--min-pass 28).
